window.source: Focused native scheduler/workgroup/USB traces, nominal then induced Serious. Same normal DSP/UI/MIDI JUCE8.0.15 build,48k/512,PD connected. Continuous K-Mix3/4 audio includes startup, trace setup/draining and thermal transition. See events and phase trace timestamps for exposure.
window.timing_note: Window local and epoch boundaries are derived from the same ISO timestamps at microsecond precision. End is nominal recorder start plus exact WAVE data-frame duration. Original separately sampled wrapper epoch timestamps and completion time are retained in wrapper_* fields and the raw recorder JSON. Independent audio clocks/start latency mean this is not sample-accurate device-log alignment.

periodic_summary.method: Consecutive 1-second bins with at least 10 short flat candidates form dense episodes. Same criterion as the earlier UI comparison. Natural quiet/smooth music can produce candidates; inspect waveform and cadence to attribute periodic blanking. Analog settling affects widths. No claim against subtle clicks.

limits: Four short native windows, same profiler configuration and verified thermal states; not a reliable failure-rate estimate.
Profiler streaming materially adds workload. The first long attempt failed its transfer-coverage gate and is preserved separately.
Native scheduler and USB-class trace is not the full Instruments Audio System Trace track set.
Scheduled intervals include any interrupt time. No CPU-frequency, peripheral electrical telemetry or returned native output samples were captured.
Captured failure rejects a simple delayed-runnable-app-audio explanation for this episode; workload may still influence driver, clock or electrical state.
Serious did not materially change measured UI/MIDI/I/O-worker wake activity or priority in these windows. Other OS policies remain unmeasured.
